Cowboys vs Giants Betting History

The Dallas Cowboys and New York Giants have met 118 times since the 1966 season. The Cowboys lead the series 74-44. Against the closing spread the Cowboys are 59-55-3 (Giants 55-59-3), and the over is 48-45 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 13, 2026, Giants 28-20.
